description: This file contains utility functions and constants related to HTTP header parsing, validation, and host name processing within the 'httpguts' package. It includes functions for token validation, header value validation, and IDNA Punycode conversion.

methods.name: IsTokenRune
methods.description: Checks if a rune is a valid token character based on the token table.

methods.name: HeaderValuesContainsToken
methods.description: Checks if any header value contains a specific token, case-insensitive.

methods.name: isOWS
methods.description: Determines if a byte is optional whitespace (space or tab).

methods.name: trimOWS
methods.description: Removes optional whitespace from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: headerValueContainsToken
methods.description: Checks if a comma-separated header value contains a specific token, case-insensitive.

methods.name: lowerASCII
methods.description: Converts an ASCII byte to its lowercase equivalent.

methods.name: tokenEqual
methods.description: Compares two strings for equality, case-insensitive, ASCII only.

methods.name: isLWS
methods.description: Checks if a byte is linear whitespace (space or tab).

methods.name: isCTL
methods.description: Checks if a byte is a control character (ASCII 0-31 or 127).

methods.name: ValidHeaderFieldName
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper HTTP header field name.

methods.name: ValidHostHeader
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper Host header value.

methods.name: ValidHeaderFieldValue
methods.description: Validates if a string is a proper HTTP header field value.

methods.name: isASCII
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only ASCII characters.

methods.name: PunycodeHostPort
methods.description: Converts a host or host:port string to its Punycode (ASCII) form, handling internationalized domain names.
